factoryName.metadata: Nombre de instancia de Data Factory

scriptLines:
query: 'SELECT
    a.pid                                                  AS "PID",
    a."MS SubClass"                                        AS "MS SubClass",
    z.code                                                 AS "MS Zoning",
    a."Roof Style"                                         AS "Roof Style",
    a."Roof Matl"                                          AS "Roof Matl",
    a."Exterior 1st"                                       AS "Exterior 1st",
    a."Exterior 2nd"                                       AS "Exterior 2nd",
    COALESCE(a."Mas Vnr Type", 'NA')                       AS "Mas Vnr Type",
    COALESCE(a."Mas Vnr Area", 0)                          AS "Mas Vnr Area",
    eq.code                                                AS "Exter Qual",
    ec.code                                                AS "Exter Cond",
    a.foundation                                           AS "Foundation",
    a.heating                                              AS "Heating",
    hq.code                                                AS "Heating QC",
    CASE WHEN a."Central Air" THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END        AS "Central Air",
    COALESCE(a.electrical, 'NA')                           AS "Electrical",
    a."1st Flr SF"                                         AS "1st Flr SF",
    a."2nd Flr SF"                                         AS "2nd Flr SF",
    a."Low Qual Fin SF"                                    AS "Low Qual Fin SF",
    a."1st Flr SF" + a."2nd Flr SF" + a."Low Qual Fin SF"  AS "Gr Liv Area",
    COALESCE(p.fullbath, 0)                                AS "Full Bath",
    COALESCE(p.halfbath, 0)                                AS "Half Bath",
    COALESCE(p.bedroom, 0)                                 AS "Bedroom AbvGr",
    a."Kitchen AbvGr"                                      AS "Kitchen AbvGr",
    kq.code                                                AS "Kitchen Qual",
    a."TotRms AbvGrd"                                      AS "TotRms AbvGrd",
    a.functional                                           AS "Functional",
    a.fireplaces                                           AS "Fireplaces",
    a."Fireplace Qu"                                       AS "Fireplace Qu",
    a."Paved Drive"                                        AS "Paved Drive",
    a."Wood Deck SF"                                       AS "Wood Deck SF",
    a."Open Porch SF"                                      AS "Open Porch SF",
    a."Enclosed Porch"                                     AS "Enclosed Porch",
    a."3Ssn Porch"                                         AS "3Ssn Porch",
    a."Screen Porch"                                       AS "Screen Porch",
    a.fence                                                AS "Fence",
    CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s."Sale Date") AS integer)     AS "Mo Sold",
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR  FROM s."Sale Date") AS integer)     AS "Yr Sold",
    s."Sale Type"                                          AS "Sale Type",
    s."Sale Condition"                                     AS "Sale Condition",
    s.saleprice                                            AS "SalePrice"
FROM public.amesdbtemp a
LEFT JOIN public.mszoning     z  ON z.id  = a."MS Zoning"
LEFT JOIN public.typequality  eq ON eq.id = a."Exter Qual"
LEFT JOIN public.typequality  ec ON ec.id = a."Exter Cond"
LEFT JOIN public.typequality  hq ON hq.id = a."Heating QC"
LEFT JOIN public.typequality  kq ON kq.id = a."Kitchen Qual"
LEFT JOIN public.saleproperty s  ON s.pid = a.pid
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT pid,
           CAST(SUM(bedrooms)    AS integer) AS bedroom,
           CAST(SUM("Full Bath") AS integer) AS fullbath,
           CAST(SUM("Half Bath") AS integer) AS halfbath
    FROM public.floordetail
    GROUP BY pid
) p ON p.pid = a.pid',
unirMisc derive({Year Remod/Add} = iifNull({Year Remod/Add}, {Year Built}),
Neighborhood == 'South & West of Iowa State University', 'SWISU',

{Condition 1} = case(     {Condition 1} == 'Normal', 'Norm',     {Condition 1} == 'Adjacent to feeder street', 'Feedr',     {Condition 1} == 'Adjacent to arterial street', 'Artery',     {Condition 1} == 'Adjacent to East-West Railroad', 'RRAe',     {Condition 1} == 'Adjacent to North-South Railroad', 'RRAn',     startsWith({Condition 1}, 'Within 200') && endsWith({Condition 1}, 'North-South Railroad'), 'RRNn',     startsWith({Condition 1}, 'Within 200') && endsWith({Condition 1}, 'East-West Railroad'), 'RRNe',     startsWith({Condition 1}, 'Near positive'), 'PosN',     startsWith({Condition 1}, 'Adjacent to pos'), 'PosA',     {Condition 1} ),

{Condition 2} = case(     {Condition 2} == 'Normal', 'Norm',     {Condition 2} == 'Adjacent to feeder street', 'Feedr',     {Condition 2} == 'Adjacent to arterial street', 'Artery',     {Condition 2} == 'Adjacent to East-West Railroad', 'RRAe',     {Condition 2} == 'Adjacent to North-South Railroad', 'RRAn',     startsWith({Condition 2}, 'Within 200') && endsWith({Condition 2}, 'North-South Railroad'), 'RRNn',     startsWith({Condition 2}, 'Within 200') && endsWith({Condition 2}, 'East-West Railroad'), 'RRNe',     startsWith({Condition 2}, 'Near positive'), 'PosN',     startsWith({Condition 2}, 'Adjacent to pos'), 'PosA',     {Condition 2} ),
{Lot Frontage} = iif(isNull({Lot Frontage}) || trim({Lot Frontage}) == '', '0', {Lot Frontage}),
